librarian: Librarian Odile: Every book here was written by someone who walked it first. Read, then go and look.

After closing, the pages on the shelves begin to rustle on their own.
Ink runs up the spines and gathers into wings made of quills.
It is Scriptorax, the ink drake. It wants to see what you will write next.
